name: print-social-halftone-folder-banner-organic-landscape
title: Green hill halftone banner with an 'organic social' folder
whatItIs: A wide banner where a halftone photo of green hills under a blue sky forms the backdrop, with a manila folder labelled 'organic social', a blue scribble at the left and tool icons around a cursor.
whatItMeans: Fresh and light; the pastoral halftone hints at 'organic' while the folder keeps it digital.
techniques: Choose a halftone background that matches the folder's subject (hills for organic).
Contrast the warm yellow folder with cool green and blue.
Overlap the blue brush stroke at the frame edge for energy.
Keep the folder centered so labels swap easily across a series.

vocabulary.definition: A layout reused with only the label changed.
A landscape photo converted to dots.
A warm object on a cool background.
A header for one content category.
